top_signals.summary: On October 1, 2025, I became President and CEO of the American Association of Community Colleges (AACC). A year has passed — full, humbling, clarifying — and I find myself wanting to mark it not...
top_signals.observation: The larger issue here is how power is being exercised inside higher education institutions, especially when boards, presidents, politics, donors, faculty, and public scrutiny collide.

top_signals.headline: Massachusetts beefs up closure warnings for at-risk colleges
top_signals.summary: Private institutions in the state will have to alert students by Dec. 31 if they might fail to meet their financial obligations within 18 months.
top_signals.observation: This seems less like a one-off story than a small sign of the pressure now being placed on colleges to do more, explain more, and absorb more complexity.
top_signals.why_it_matters: This seems less like a one-off story than a small sign of the pressure now being placed on colleges to do more, explain more, and absorb more complexity.

top_signals.headline: California Community Colleges wants AI funded to tune of $195M
top_signals.summary: In its 2027-28 state budget proposal, the public system emphasized the importance of a unified adoption of artificial intelligence practices and policies.
top_signals.observation: The AI conversation is starting to move from novelty toward implementation: governance, training, workload, equity, and the points where human judgment still matters.

top_signals.headline: Complex pathways lengthen time to completion
top_signals.summary: The median time it takes community college students to earn an associate degree is 2.9 years. For those earning a certificate at a community college, it’s 2.3 years. Those are among the findings in a...
top_signals.observation: The part that caught my attention is the operational burden. Student success work does not scale by aspiration alone.

top_signals.headline: College Leaders Prepare to Administer Workforce Pell as ED Approves Programs
top_signals.summary: College Leaders Prepare to Administer Workforce Pell as ED Approves Programs Olivia.sanchez Thu, 10/01/2026 - 03:00 AM Institutions have to ensure that their financial aid officers and software systems are ready to administer aid for short-term programs and that students know the opportunity exists. Byline(s) Olivia Sanchez
top_signals.observation: This is now an implementation story rather than a policy announcement. The useful questions are which programs qualify, how quickly colleges can build compliant offerings, and whether students receive enough guidance to judge short-term credentials well.
